scleractinian_coral_septa_specimen.species: Caryophyllia (Caryophyllia) quadragenaria (Alcock, 1902) — solitary Scleractinian cup coral showing top-down calice view (upper panel, rows 0..440) with 4 hexameral Milne-Edwards cycles of radiating septa (S1..S4, 40 visible outer septa at 9.0 deg mean spacing), pali crown, and fascicular columella, plus side profile view of the costate trochoid corallum (middle panel)

governing_equations.section: Milne-Edwards & Haime (1848) Ann. Sci. Nat. Zool. 9:37-89; Kunth (1869) Z. Dtsch. Geol. Ges. 21:647-688; Kaandorp & Kübler (2001) Ch. 4-6; Chindapol et al. (2013) PLoS Comput. Biol. 9(1):e1002849 Eqs. (1)-(8)
governing_equations.milne_edwards_cycle_insertion_count: n_1 = 6,   n_k = 6 * 2^(k-2) for k >= 2 (new septa inserted in cycle k at the midpoints of all existing interseptal loculi)
governing_equations.perimeter_wavelength_threshold_law: 2 * pi * R_k = N_hex(k) * lambda_s  =>  R_k = (3 * lambda_s / pi) * 2^(k-1),   k(R) = 1 + floor(log2(pi * R / (3 * lambda_s)))
governing_equations.septal_radial_reach_hierarchy_law: L_k / R = alpha_k = alpha_1 * q_reach^(k-1) with alpha_1 > alpha_2 > alpha_3 > alpha_4 > alpha_5 (strictly decreasing radial reach with cycle order k)
governing_equations.kunth_rugosa_serial_quadrant_law: N_rugosa(m) = 6 + 4 * m (6 protosepta: cardinal, counter, 2 alar, 2 counter-lateral; plus 4*m metasepta inserted serially in 4 fossulae)
governing_equations.chindapol_peclet_advection_diffusion_law: u . grad(c) = D * laplacian(c),   Pe = U * L / D,   j_n(theta; Pe) = j_0 * (1 + beta_Pe * sqrt(Pe) * cos(theta) + gamma_Pe * (Pe / (1 + Pe)) * cos(2*theta)),   A_1(Pe) = (j_upstream - j_downstream) / (j_upstream + j_downstream) = beta_Pe * sqrt(Pe) / (1 + gamma_Pe * Pe / (1 + Pe))
